Module: Nexus Community (Blockchain-Based Lightweight Decentralized Secure Communication Platform)
Problem: Traditional collaboration software stores message logs, identities, and shared files in plaintext on cloud databases, creating a single point of failure (SPOF) vulnerable to server leaks, administrator tampering, and forensic traffic analysis.
Solution: A hybrid secure communication architecture that splits roles: a centralized Node/PostgreSQL/Socket.IO backend coordinates routing and SFU video conferencing, while the client maintains cryptographic ownership via browser-sandboxed did:key ECDSA signatures, AES-256-GCM encryption-at-rest, a local Proof-of-Work hash chain audit, and multi-media steganography.
Tech Stack: Next.js 16, Tailwind CSS v4, TypeScript, Node.js (Hono), WebRTC, Socket.IO, Clerk Auth, UploadThing CDN, LiveKit SFU, Prisma & PostgreSQL
API Requirements: REST endpoints (/api/servers, /api/steganography, /api/blockchain, /api/internal/purge-expired), Socket.io WebSocket connections, and WebRTC signaling broker (ws://localhost:3001)
